sentences.text: S.B. Criminal Revision No. 1075/2018 Girraj Prasad S/o Late Sjri Prabhu Dayal , Aged About 49 Years,

R/o Ladia Mohalla, Shopkeeper South West Block Alwar ( At Present In District Jail Alwar)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan , Jaipur  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Gajender Singh Rathore For Respondent(s) : Mr. V.S. Godara, PP HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPAK MAHESHWARI
Judgment / Order 03/07/2018 Heard learned counsel for the accused-petitioner as well as learned Public Prosecutor on the application for suspension of sentence.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the accused- petitioner was on bail during trial as well as during pendency of the appeal.
There is no previous conviction recorded against the accused-petitioner.
Both the material witnesses namely PW-1 Omveer Singh and PW-2 Rajkumar Sharma have admitted that no stirring was properly made by the food inspector prior to taking the sample.

Counsel further submits that the matter pertains to the year 2000, since then no case has been registered against the accused-petitioner for any offence under Prevention of Food (2 of 2)
[CRLR-1075/2018] Adulteration Act and the accused-petitioner is in custody since 27.06.2018.
The revision petition is likely to take time to be decided on merits.

Accordingly, the application for suspension of sentence is allowed and it is ordered that the sentence passed by learned trial court and affirmed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge No.2, Alwar vide his judgment dated 27.06.2018 passed in Criminal Appeal No.77/2012 against the accused-petitioner Girraj Prasad S/o Late Shri Prabhu Dayal shall remain suspended till final disposal of present revision petition provided he executes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- along with two sureties in the sum of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance in this Court on 03.08.2018 and, as and when called upon to do so.
